acceptanceCriteria: The cite refusal states the rule (cited base span must survive the change) and, if cheap, nearest stable spans; the prepare refusal names a fix (git repack -a -d and remove objects/info/alternates, or clone without --shared); tests pin the messages.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1331. cem cite --lines on removed lines refuses cite-span-not-stable with no hint of citable spans; cem prepare in a --shared clone refuses unsupported-object-alternates with no suggested fix.
title: cem refusals cite-span-not-stable and unsupported-object-alternates give no fix
